note: Both sets correctly capture the two annotated figure values (∂P/∂θ at θ=0° = -25.52E+6 watt/rad and θK = 6.302336°) and both repeat them redundantly under misbound entities such as 'Blade-Pitch Controller' or 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch'. Set B uniquely captures the doubling relation of Eq. (7-17), which Set A omits, but it also adds two invented values (-90E+6 and -30E+6) labeled 'estimated from Figure 7-3' with only an axis label as quote, plus several truncated quotes (∂θ (θ=0º)…). Set A is more economical: it has fewer unsupported graph-read and misbound claims while retaining the key annotated values and the doubling condition, so it is the better set overall despite missing the explicit relation.
